cohort: The study examined formalin fixed, paraffin embedded (FFPE) surgical or autopsy intestinal tissue from 310 infants (156 with NEC, 37 with SIP) for pathogen detection.
finding: Molecular testing yielded few gastrointestinal pathogens in intestinal tissue of infants with NEC or SIP, suggesting these organisms are likely not major causes or facilitators of these conditions.
